links.outcome: Standalone AI agreement with clinician on sonographic feature classification
links.effect: Categorical feature agreement was fair to moderate (κ = 0.196-0.368); highest for echogenic foci, lowest for echogenicity. Study reports concordance, not human-AI team performance.
links.quote: For categorical features, agreement ranged from fair to moderate (κ = 0.196-0.368), with the highest concordance for echogenic foci and lowest for echogenicity.

screen.reason: Retrospective study evaluating agreement and calibration between an AI-based ultrasound tool and expert clinician assessments on archived thyroid nodule images.
